name: Tic-tac-toe
description: Don't be surprised, if during a heated battle someone will invite you to play Tic-tac-toe. You're probably facing a professional, who left plenty of opponents defeated in the dust.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on 16th October 2018, as part of a Star Week event. Simultaneously it was added to Containers permanently.
Tic-tac-toe was given to all players who got 700 or more Stars during the Star Hunt event that took place October 16-22, 2018.
